title: More choices in the text API
summary:
August broadened the text model lineup and community project catalog while making image caching and API usage easier to inspect.

The model list gained GPT-5 options, OpenAI o3, Claude 3.5 Haiku, Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite, DeepSeek R1 0528, and the `roblox-rp` model. Routing and access settings were adjusted alongside them.

Community additions ranged from multilingual chat assistants and a prompt-to-diagram tool to image generators and creative toolboxes. The front page also regained generation counters, and the catalog became easier to browse.

The image cache was split into replaceable components, then gained multilingual prompt matching and length-aware similarity thresholds. Response headers now show whether a hit was exact or semantic, and semantic hits report their similarity score.

Access guidance moved to tier wording after the Special Bee request path was removed. Text-request events gained model, timing, token, and moderation details; completions and usage records now include the user's tier.
